newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine GDP fell 10.0 pct in 1996 vs 1995.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine GDP fell 10.0 pct in 1996 vs 1995.

text.p: Ukrainian gross domestic product fell 10 percent in 1996 from the 1995 level, the Statistics Ministry said on Wednesday.
The government is now forecasting zero growth in gross domestic product this year.
The Ukrainian government previously estimated that GDP fell 11.8 percent last year. It had also forecast economic growth of about 1.7 percent in 1997.
Note - Official Ukrainian statistics tend to under-report a growing shadow economy, estimated to occupy as much as half of all economic activity.
